Hello everyone,

Currently im in The Titans, i like it, i really do. 
But since it is kind of a team that helps u to get into teams i just want to make this thread.
I just want a good active team that also wins scrims some time


Position: Defender

Timezone: GMT +1

Experience: Mars, Team Rocket, Home, Crede and The Titans

Discord: mels159 #3865

Extra: Leaders will be looking to my kd or they know how I defend. I think a lot of them will think that im not good enough. I agree with them but i want to learn more about defending and being a good teammate. So I hope some people will give me a shot.

Mels
